[[Summit Beastmaster]]s are [[Stone Summit]] that have enslaved [[snow beast]]s for use as war mounts, manipulating them through the use of a complex harness made up of chains and manacles.

==Notes==
*Summit Beastmasters have a visual animation when activating Giant Stomp. Watch for the animation when predicting to [[interrupt]] the skill or when you should cast spells. 
*[[Pain Inverter]] is very useful against them before they use Giant Stomp, as it will trigger damage for every ally knocked down, as well as any nearby foes that happen to be knocked down.
